answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by demanding that every identity stake non-trivial collateral, slashed when duplicates are proven linked. Each fake agent a scammer mints costs real value, so a thousand cheap copper copies multiply the loss once correlation is found. Because reputation is written to a shared ledge, every history sits open to audit; no operator can silently hoist a swarm onto a higher terrace of trust without paying the full price for each rung.
